verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents an official MCP server, with a configuration guide for connecting any MCP-capable agent, authentication, and a tools reference covering query, trace, Board, Trigger, SLO, and Canvas tools. An independent HN practitioner also describes using Honeycomb's MCP server as an agent tool source. Missing for 10: in-depth independent hands-on corroboration (the community mention is brief) and detailed per-client setup and auth specifics in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect your AI agent to the Honeycomb MCP Server.
Connect Honeycomb to any AI agent that supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) so it can query your telemetry, investigate issues, and answer questions using your live Honeycomb data.
Reference for the tools Honeycomb MCP exposes to AI agents, including discovery, query, trace, Board, Trigger, SLO, and Canvas investigation tools.
Once your agent authenticates, it can query your telemetry, investigate issues, and answer questions using your live Honeycomb data.
An LLM agent given tool calls for each source, including Honeycomb's MCP server, can generate integrated hypotheses.
